name: CV4A Competition Kenya Crop Type Dataset
description: The CV4A Competition Kenya Crop Type Dataset is an agricultural earth observation benchmark released by the Radiant Earth Foundation in conjunction with the Computer Vision for Agriculture (CV4A) Workshop at ICLR 2020. Spanning western Kenya (Busia and Uasin Gishu counties), the dataset couples ground-surveyed agricultural field boundary polygons with multi-temporal Sentinel-2 multi-spectral satellite imagery acquired across 13 distinct dates during the 2019 agricultural growing season. Providing ground-truth crop labels (Maize, Cassava, Common Beans, and mixed cropping patterns), the benchmark fosters machine learning models for smallholder crop mapping, food security monitoring, and agricultural yield prediction in Sub-Saharan Africa.
